activities.name: SendFile
activities.whenToUse: Use to send Config.Content with an attachment file from Config.FullPath to the channel identified by ItemSignal @.Id. The Discord provider constructs a multipart REST request, so the file path and provider resource/address must be available.
activities.description: Send a file through a network service.

properties.description: Read the configuration object and warn when it is absent or false-valued.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the request Config object for Network_DiscordBot SendFile. The provider warns when it is absent or false-valued and has no enabled environment fallback.

properties.description: Provide text serialized into the multipart message payload when sending a file.
properties.whenToUse: Supply message text to accompany the uploaded file. SendFile converts this value to text in its multipart message payload.

properties.description: Provide the attachment file path used in the multipart file upload.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the local attachment file path used by the multipart upload. This is an effectful file-read and network-send path.

result.description: Discord response body [provider-returned]. When configured Discord channel and REST POST; REST response succeeds.

resultNotes: Network_DiscordBot: Response schema and delivery state depend on provider; no live send receipt was observed

activities.name: SendMessage
activities.whenToUse: Use to send Config.Content to the channel identified by ItemSignal @.Id. The provider splits text into chunks of at most 2000 characters and sends each through a REST request.

properties.description: Read the configuration object and warn when it is absent or false-valued.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the request Config object for Network_DiscordBot SendMessage. The provider warns when absent or false-valued; no environment Config fallback is enabled.

properties.description: Provide message text split into chunks of at most 2000 characters and sent as message bodies.
properties.whenToUse: Supply message text to send. The provider splits it into at-most-2000-character chunks before constructing network requests.

result.description: Discord response body [provider-returned]. When configured Discord channel and REST POST; REST response succeeds.

resultNotes: Network_DiscordBot: Response schema and delivery state depend on provider; no live send receipt was observed

activities.name: ReadBatch
activities.whenToUse: Use to fetch Discord channel messages and optionally poll for a reply to prior message objects located through Plan.Path; each object must carry an id for matching. PollUntilResponse true has no finite internal bound and can continue indefinitely without a matching reply or failure.

properties.description: Read the configuration object and warn when it is absent or false-valued.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the request Config object for Network_DiscordBot ReadBatch. The provider warns when absent or false-valued; channel/resource inputs come from its current signals.

properties.description: Set the message limit query parameter for the batch request.
properties.whenToUse: Set the message limit in the batch request query. Omit to use the provider's default 10.

properties.description: Set the delay in milliseconds between polling iterations when polling continues.
properties.whenToUse: Set the milliseconds between ReadBatch polling iterations when polling continues. Omit to use 5000 milliseconds.

properties.description: Control whether batch polling continues after a response unless a matching reply ends the operation.
properties.whenToUse: Set true only when continued polling for a matching reply is intended; there is no finite internal iteration bound, so without matching prior-message context it can continue indefinitely. Omit or false for one request.

properties.description: Optionally locate prior messages in ItemSignal to match replies in the fetched batch.
properties.whenToUse: Optionally supply an ItemSignal path holding prior message objects, each with an id member, for matching fetched message_reference.message_id values. Bare ID strings do not match the source's object-member read.

result.description: When configured Discord message GET; message_reference.message_id matches.
When configured Discord message GET; nonpoll response.

resultNotes: Network_DiscordBot: Provider envelope/cardinality needs a bound response; poll mode lacks a deadline

activities.name: HandleMessage
activities.whenToUse: Use to select existing message content from ItemSignal at Plan.Path for a local result. This branch does not itself send a Discord request.

properties.description: Read the configuration object and warn when it is absent or false-valued.
properties.whenToUse: The provider reads Config before HandleMessage and warns if absent or false-valued, though message lookup uses Plan.Path on ItemSignal.

properties.description: Select message content from ItemSignal for the activity result.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the ItemSignal path containing message content to return from HandleMessage.

result.description: When Path selects message from ItemSignal; message resolves.

resultNotes: Network_DiscordBot: No Format postprocessing occurs in this branch
